main_text.p: Quantum boni potest exemplum bonum, ad mandatorum DEI observationem, tantum mali contra potest exemplum malum ad abstrahendum ab observatione illâ.
main_text.head: ARTICULUS XVI.
De Prædestinatione divinâ.
main_text.p: CRedimus DEUM, postquam tota A-dami soboles, sic in perditionem & exitium primi hominis culpâ praecipitata fuit, seipsum talem demonstrasse ac praestitisse, qualis est revera: nimirum misericordem & justum. Misericordem quidem eos damna-tione & interitu liberando & servando, quos in æterno & immutabili consilio suo, 1. pro merâ & gratuitâ suâ bonitate, per IESUM CHRISTUM Dominum nostrum elegit, 2. sine ullo [bonorum] operum ipsorum respectu. 3. Justum verò, alios in illo suo lapsu & perditione relinquendo, in quam sese ipsi præcipites dederunt. 4. [Hac ratione declarat se esse misericordem & clementem DEUM ijs quos salvos facit, quibus nihil debebat: uti quoque se declarat justum judicem ostensione justæ severitatis suæ erga reliquos. Atque

page.notes: Underlining in red and green ink appears under quos, elegit, relinquendo, quos salvos facit and DEVM ijs; these are later marks, not print, and are not transcribed. The italic line above the rule is treated as a text line of the page top, not as a running title. The word "[bonorum]" is printed in square brackets. The page number 58 is printed at upper left. The printed "exemplum malum" is in italic. Some letters at the top right of the scan show show-through from the reverse side, which was not transcribed.
